title: Language Model Integration
summary: This module provides the core infrastructure for integrating and managing various Language Models (LMs) within DSPy. It includes client interfaces for different LM providers, caching mechanisms for efficient interaction, streaming capabilities for real-time output, and provider-specific integrations for advanced features like finetuning.

nodes.label: Manage LLM Clients
nodes.title: LLM Client Interfaces
nodes.description: Provides the foundational interfaces for interacting with various Language Models, including base classes, LiteLLM wrappers, and local LM management.

nodes.label: Optimize with Caching & Embeddings
nodes.title: Caching & Embedding Services
nodes.description: Implements caching mechanisms for expensive LM calls and embedding computations, ensuring efficient reuse of results and secure disk serialization.

nodes.label: Enable LLM Output Streaming
nodes.title: Real-time Output Streaming
nodes.description: Facilitates incremental streaming of DSPy program outputs, allowing for real-time feedback and custom processing of streamed content from LMs.

nodes.label: Integrate Provider-Specific Features
nodes.title: Provider-Specific Integrations
nodes.description: Offers specialized integrations for particular LM providers, including logging control for LiteLLM and management of finetuning jobs for platforms like Databricks and OpenAI.

edges.label: Utilizes for caching
edges.title: LM Clients Use Caching
edges.description: Language Model clients leverage the caching module to store and retrieve responses, reducing redundant API calls and improving performance.

edges.label: Provides raw streams to
edges.title: LM Clients Feed Streaming
edges.description: The core LM clients generate raw, incremental output streams that are then processed and managed by the streaming module.

edges.label: Configures/Enhances
edges.title: Provider Integrations Affect Clients
edges.description: Provider-specific modules configure or extend the behavior of general LM clients, for example, by enabling detailed logging or managing finetuning processes.

groups.label: Core LM Interaction
groups.title: Core Language Model Interaction
groups.description: The central component responsible for abstracting and managing direct communication with various Language Models.

groups.label: Performance & Data Optimization
groups.title: Performance & Data Optimization
groups.description: Modules focused on enhancing efficiency through caching and providing embedding services for data processing.

groups.label: Real-time Output Handling
groups.title: Real-time Output Handling
groups.description: Manages the incremental delivery and processing of Language Model outputs for real-time user experiences.

groups.label: Vendor-Specific Features
groups.title: Vendor-Specific Features
groups.description: Provides specialized functionalities and integrations tailored to specific Language Model providers and platforms.
